components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #161b22; color: #d8dde3; border: 1px solid #2a3140; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1f2630; border-color: #58a6ff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #58a6ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Dark terminal CM dashboard. Sidebar + single active view. Data density over decoration.
